achievements.description: Take down Castro with a headshot.
achievements.summary: Kill Castro with a headshot in Operation 40.

steps.text: Aim at Castro's head when you get him in your sights; a headshot is the only way to kill him.

achievements.description: Ensure your squad escapes safely from Cuba.
achievements.summary: Finish the Operation 40 mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Operation 40 to the end.

achievements.description: Destroy all enemies on vehicles during the prison break.
achievements.summary: Destroy every enemy that rides a vehicle during the Vorkuta prison break.

guide.context: Destroy the vehicles and also kill any crew left alive. A rider you leave alive costs you the achievement, so retry the mission if one gets away.

steps.text: After the slingshot section, destroy the two parked trucks and kill the rest of their crews.
When you get the @item{Death Machine}, shoot the trucks and their crews. Before the tear gas arrives, also blow up the three trucks far in the distance.
On the motorbike, shoot the bikers chasing you and the single truck on the route; it dies in one shot but is easy to miss.
On the truck with the minigun, destroy the trucks and bikes behind you and the helicopter above. The achievement should unlock before the train appears.

achievements.displayName: Give me liberty, or give me death
achievements.description: Escape Vorkuta.
achievements.summary: Finish the Vorkuta mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Vorkuta to the end.

achievements.description: Destroy all slingshot targets in 3 attempts.
achievements.summary: Destroy all slingshot targets in Vorkuta using no more than 3 attempts.

steps.text: At the slingshot, put the bottom of the reticle on each building before you launch. If a building survives, restart the checkpoint or mission.

achievements.description: Receive orders from Lancer.
achievements.summary: Watch the U.S.D.D. briefing until Lancer gives you your orders.

steps.text: Let the U.S.D.D. mission play through; it is a cutscene mission with no actions needed.

achievements.description: Sabotage the Soviet space program.
achievements.summary: Finish the Executive Order mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Executive Order to the end.

achievements.description: Use no more than 6 TOW guided missiles to destroy the tanks in the defense of Khe Sanh.
achievements.summary: Take out all six tanks at Khe Sanh while firing at most 6 TOW missiles.

guide.context: You have six tanks and six missiles, so every shot must hit.

steps.text: Aim each missile at a tank marked with red diamonds and steer around obstacles.
If you miss, quickly fly the missile back into the tank before the timer ends.

achievements.description: Break the siege in the battle of Khe Sanh.
achievements.summary: Finish the S.O.G. mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play S.O.G. to the end.

achievements.description: Retrieve the dossier and the defector from Hue City.
achievements.summary: Finish The Defector mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play The Defector to the end.

achievements.description: Rack up a body count of 20 NVA using air support in Hue City.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 NVA with air support in The Defector.

guide.context: Kills from different calls add up across the mission. The helicopter is unavailable for one part of the mission and returns later.

steps.text: Call in the helicopter every time it is available and let it kill NVA.

achievements.description: Kill 10 NVA with Dragon's Breath rounds.
achievements.summary: Get 10 NVA kills using incendiary Dragon's Breath shotgun rounds.

steps.text: Use the @item{SPAS-12} with incendiary rounds that you are given at the start of The Defector until you have 10 kills.

achievements.description: Use the Grim Reaper to destroy the MG emplacement.
achievements.summary: Destroy the MG emplacement in Victor Charlie with the Grim Reaper.

steps.text: After you destroy the ZPU, keep the @item{Grim Reaper} (M-202 quad rocket launcher). Fire one rocket at the MG emplacement ahead.

achievements.description: Silently take out 3 VC.
achievements.summary: Silently kill 3 VC in Victor Charlie.

steps.text: Knife the VC on the boat, the one in the bunk bed and the one eating an apple without being spotted. Following Woods closely helps.

achievements.description: Use only dual wield weapons to escape Kowloon.
achievements.summary: Escape Kowloon using only dual-wield weapons.

guide.context: Never fire or aim a one-handed weapon at any time. Dual-wield weapons cannot be aimed, so deal with far-off enemies carefully.

steps.text: Pick up dual-wield weapons whenever one is available and use only those until the mission ends.

achievements.description: Escape Kowloon.
achievements.summary: Finish the Numbers mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Numbers to the end.

achievements.description: Destroy all targets and structures while making your way up the river.
achievements.summary: Destroy every target and structure on the river run in Crash Site.

guide.context: Every boat, building, guard tower and vehicle counts, including the buildings at the final boat battle. One wall left standing blocks the achievement.

steps.text: Fire rockets at every structure you pass until it is completely gone.
Clear the buildings at the final boat battle before the mission ends.

achievements.description: Find the Soviet connection in Laos.
achievements.summary: Finish the Crash Site mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Crash Site to the end.

achievements.description: Guide the squad through the Soviet outpost without them getting killed.
achievements.summary: In WMD, lead Hudson's squad past the Soviet outpost with every squad member surviving.

steps.text: In the Blackbird, follow the orders you are given so no friendly is killed.

achievements.description: Enter the Soviet relay station undetected.
achievements.summary: Enter the Soviet relay station in WMD without raising an alarm.

guide.context: A @item{crossbow} is quiet and kills in one hit.

steps.text: After the Blackbird part, kill the guards outside the first garage: the wandering guard, then the one on the barrel. Do not shoot the man repairing the machine.
Kill the guard on the windshield of the truck; a friendly usually kills the other mechanic. Do not shoot the man in the next garage.
Kill the guard on the station who looks down at you. Then kill the two guards to your left and the guards outside and inside the next garage.
Kill the last guard before the catwalk, zooming in to spot him.

achievements.description: Get to the POW compound in the Hind using only rockets.
achievements.summary: Fly the Hind to the POW compound firing nothing but its rockets.

guide.context: The mounted cannons must never be fired. A lower difficulty makes this easier.

steps.text: Fly the Hind to the compound in Payback and use only the rocket weapon.

achievements.description: Incinerate 10 enemies with the flamethrower attachment in the POW compound.
achievements.summary: Burn 10 enemies to death with the flamethrower attachment at the POW compound.

guide.context: The enemy must be fully set on fire. Do this in one life.

steps.text: In Payback, grab the flame-throwing AK-47 and burn 10 enemies.

achievements.description: Escape the ship with 2:15 left on the timer in Veteran.
achievements.summary: On Veteran in Project Nova, leave the ship while the timer still shows 2:15.

guide.context: The clock stops once you use the winch. Aim to have more than 2:15 remaining.

steps.text: Before planting the explosive, kill as many enemies as you can on the catwalk above.
Shoot out the support beam on your left, then keep running unless an enemy blocks you.
At the checkpoint check the timer; if you have less than about 2:30, restart.
Run to the bow and grapple onto the railing to leave the ship.

achievements.description: Escape the past.
achievements.summary: Finish the Project Nova mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Project Nova to the end.

achievements.description: Kill 7 monkeys in under 10 seconds in the Rebirth labs.
achievements.summary: Kill 7 monkeys within 10 seconds in the Rebirth labs.

guide.context: Monkeys killed by the Nova 6 gas in the chamber do not count.

steps.text: In the hallway before the gas chamber, throw a hand grenade at the monkeys at the back right of the room so all seven die within 10 seconds.

achievements.description: Make it through the NOVA 6 gas without dying on Rebirth Island.
achievements.summary: Get through the Nova 6 gas on Rebirth Island without dying as Hudson.

guide.context: Hudson's health does not regenerate, and each hit cracks his suit. Move slowly and avoid damage.

steps.text: Play Hudson's section and reach the compound without dying; an @item{Enfield} with an IR scope makes it easier.

achievements.description: Crack the code.
achievements.summary: Finish the Revelations mission on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play Revelations to the end.

achievements.description: Destroy both helicopters with one Valkyrie missile from the deck of the ship.
achievements.summary: Destroy both helicopters with one Valkyrie missile from the ship's deck in Redemption.

guide.context: A low difficulty makes this easier.

steps.text: Launch a Valkyrie missile and steer it toward the two helicopters. Press fire to detonate it when both are close, or when one helicopter crashes into the other.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign on Hardened or Veteran difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the whole campaign on Hardened or Veteran difficulty.

guide.context: The campaign includes the U.S.D.D. and Revelations missions.

steps.text: Play every mission on Hardened or Veteran. Veteran also covers the Veteran-only achievements.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Complete the final mission, Redemption.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with a single frag grenade in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 enemies with one frag grenade in the campaign.

guide.context: Red barrel and car explosions count if five enemies die at once.

steps.text: In Operation 40, after leaving the villa, throw a frag at the truck crew near the red barrel so the barrel explosion kills them all.
Retry from the checkpoint if you get fewer than five kills.

achievements.description: Demonstrate killer economic sensibilities by taking down 3 enemies with a single bullet
achievements.summary: Take down 3 enemies with one bullet.

guide.context: It also works in Zombies, but the campaign has easy spots.

steps.text: In Executive Order, three soldiers stand in a row; shoot them with a @item{Python} using Speed Reloader.
In Numbers, line enemies up in the hallway after the first weapons cache and fire a @item{PSG1}.

achievements.description: Use the explosive bolts to kill 30 enemies in the campaign.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with the crossbow's explosive bolts.

guide.context: The count adds up across missions, so you do not need to do it in one go.

steps.text: Use the explosive bolts of the @item{crossbow}, for example in Executive Order, until you reach 30 kills.

achievements.description: Complete "Operation 40," "Vorkuta," and "Executive Order" on Veteran difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat Operation 40, Vorkuta and Executive Order, all on Veteran.

steps.text: Play all three missions on Veteran and complete each one.

achievements.description: Complete "SOG" and "The Defector" on Veteran difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat the S.O.G. and The Defector missions on Veteran.

steps.text: Play both missions on Veteran and complete each one.

achievements.description: Complete "Numbers," "Project Nova," and "Victor Charlie" on Veteran difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat Numbers, Project Nova and Victor Charlie, all on Veteran.

steps.text: Play all three missions on Veteran and complete each one.

achievements.description: Complete "Crash Site," "WMD," and "Payback" on Veteran difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat Crash Site, WMD and Payback, all on Veteran.

steps.text: Play all three missions on Veteran and complete each one.

achievements.description: Complete "Rebirth" and "Redemption" on Veteran difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish Rebirth and Redemption on Veteran difficulty.

guide.context: Revelations also needs to be completed on Veteran, even though it is not named.

steps.text: Play Rebirth, Revelations and Redemption on Veteran and complete each one.

achievements.description: Find all the hidden intel.
achievements.summary: Find all 42 hidden intel items in the campaign.

guide.context: Each mission has 3 golden tape players, except U.S.D.D., which has none. Collected intel stays saved even if you die at once or start a new game. Do not use the terminal code that gives all intel, because it locks this achievement.

achievements.summary: Purchase every wall weapon during one Zombies game.

achievements.displayName: See Me, Stab Me, Heal Me
achievements.description: Revive a downed ally from a distance with a Pack-a-Punched Ballistic Knife.
achievements.summary: Revive a downed ally from a distance with a Pack-a-Punched Ballistic Knife.

guide.context: You need a second player. Offline split screen is easiest because the Mystery Box stays in place.

steps.text: Get the @item{Ballistic Knife} from the Mystery Box (950 points).
Pack-a-Punch it (5000 points).
When your ally is downed, fire the knife at them to revive them.

achievements.description: Kill the Pentagon thief before it can steal your load-out.
achievements.summary: Kill the Pentagon thief before it steals your weapon.

guide.context: This only happens in the Zombies map Five, which opens after you finish the campaign. After the power is on, the thief appears every 5 to 7 rounds.

steps.text: Turn on the power in Five.
When the room goes dark and the computer announces an intruder, go to the catwalk.
Shoot the thief with your strongest weapon, such as a Ray Gun, LMG or Pack-a-Punched weapon, before it reaches you.

achievements.description: Kill 6 zombies after getting shot by a Pack-a-Punched Crossbow bolt.
achievements.summary: Get 6 zombie kills after taking a hit from a Pack-a-Punched Crossbow bolt.

guide.context: You need a second player. Shooting a downed ally does not count.

steps.text: Get the @item{Crossbow} from the Mystery Box and Pack-a-Punch it (5000 points). Do it early, because it stops killing in one hit in later rounds.
Have your ally shoot you, or shoot them yourself, with the Pack-a-Punched crossbow, then kill 6 zombies.
To gather zombies first, throw a monkey bomb, shoot the ally, then have them run into the crowd around it.

achievements.description: Access the terminal and battle the forces of the Cosmic Silverback in Dead Ops Arcade.
achievements.summary: Start Dead Ops Arcade from the main-menu terminal.

steps.text: Break free from the chair, walk to the terminal and type DOA.

achievements.description: In Dead Ops Arcade, use a Speed Boost to blast through 20 or more enemies at one time.
achievements.summary: Use a Speed Boost in Dead Ops Arcade to run through 20 or more enemies at once.

steps.text: Lead many zombies behind you, then take a Speed Boost and run through them. It works on the first level.

achievements.description: Break free from the torture chair in the main menu.
achievements.summary: Break free from the torture chair in the main menu.

steps.text: On the main menu, hold the Space bar until you are free.

achievements.description: Play Zork on the main-menu terminal.
achievements.summary: Play Zork on the main-menu terminal.

steps.text: After breaking free from the chair, go to the terminal and type zork.

achievements.description: In Ascension, escape on all 3 lunar landers.
achievements.summary: In Ascension, ride all 3 lunar landers.

guide.context: Open all areas and turn on the power first. You can ride them in any order.

steps.text: Ride the lander left of the upper spawn door, past Stamin-Up.
Ride the lander right of the upper spawn door in the large area; go up the stairs.
Ride the lander past the power area and Speed Cola, straight ahead.

achievements.description: In Ascension, kill at least 5 zombies with 1 Gersh Device.
achievements.summary: In Ascension, take out 5 or more zombies with a single Gersh Device.

steps.text: Get the @item{Gersh Device} from the Mystery Box and throw it into a crowd; it pulls zombies in and kills them.

achievements.description: In Ascension, Pack-a-Punch a weapon by round 8.
achievements.summary: In Ascension, upgrade a weapon at Pack-a-Punch before round 8 begins.

guide.context: Pack-a-Punch only opens after you ride all landers and launch the rocket. Play solo to save points.

steps.text: For rounds 3 and 4, use only the M1911 and knife; avoid perks, Insta-Kill and Nukes.
By round 3 or 4, open the upper door and buy the MP5K.
At round 7, switch on the power, ride every lander, launch the rocket, then upgrade a weapon at Pack-a-Punch.

achievements.description: In Ascension, kill a space monkey with a fire trap.
achievements.summary: In Ascension, burn a space monkey to death in a fire trap.

guide.context: A few rounds after you switch on the power and buy a perk, the monkeys show up.

steps.text: Let a monkey take a perk and lead it to the fire trap near Stamin-Up, then switch the trap on.

achievements.description: In Call of the Dead, send the crew to Paradise in solo or co-op.
achievements.summary: In Call of the Dead, finish the Paradise Easter egg, alone or with others.

guide.context: The Easter egg steps are listed under Ensemble Cast. Some steps are marked as needing a second player.

steps.text: Follow the Ensemble Cast steps.

achievements.description: In Call of the Dead, send the crew to Paradise in co-op
achievements.summary: In Call of the Dead, finish the Paradise Easter egg with at least one other player.

guide.context: Steps 4, 5, 7 and 8 need a second player. If step 8 fails, try it before step 5.

steps.text: Turn on the power at the top of the ship's bridge.
Knife the vault door in the room under PhD Flopper. Look for the fuse in the room above on that floor and put it in the slot by the door. Knife the door once more.

Switch off the 4 security generators; Semtex grenades work best. They are opposite the vault door, past the railing in the water at Double Tap, among the ice shelves amidships, and outside by a window at Stamin-Up.

Fetch the vodka bottle frozen in ice at one of 4 spots: the ramp joining the ship's halves, beside the Mystery Box over PhD Flopper, high up by the MPL wall buy, or on the staircase from that box down to PhD Flopper. One player knifes the ice while another waits underneath to catch the bottle. Drop it in the tube left of the vault door.

Press the 4 radios in the right order: on the electrical cabinet under the power room, on the barrel beside Stamin-Up, on its side in the shipping container by the zip-line exit, and on the cabinet beneath the stairs by the vault. A light in the sky then flashes Morse code.
In the power room, turn the ship's wheel so the brown peg points bottom right, pull the left lever once and the right-most lever 3 times.

Press the 4 foghorns in the right order: by the water beside the AK-74u wall buy on its right, around the corner on the right once you slide down to Speed Cola, at the base of the building on the left of that wall buy, and straight ahead after the Speed Cola slide.
In the lighthouse, set the dials (yellow, orange, blue, purple from top): yellow to 2, blue until orange shows 7, purple to 6, orange until blue shows 4, yellow to 2.
One player pulls the @item{V-R11} from the box and shoots a zombie on the lighthouse's ground floor. It turns human and floats up the spiral stairs; kill him before he reaches the top.
Pick up the Vrill Device, place it in the same tube as the vodka, knife the fuse box after Richtofen speaks and send the crew to Paradise.

achievements.description: In Call of the Dead, make a zombie explode using the V-R11
achievements.summary: In Call of the Dead, blow up a zombie using the V-R11.

steps.text: Upgrade the @item{V-R11} at Pack-a-Punch, then hit one zombie with two shots.

achievements.description: In Call of the Dead, kill 10 zombies with one Scavenger shot from over 100 feet away
achievements.summary: In Call of the Dead, fire a single Scavenger shot from more than 100 feet away that kills 10 zombies.

steps.text: Use the @item{Scavenger} on a large group of zombies from more than 100 feet away so one shot kills 10.

achievements.description: In Call of the Dead, cut the lights on the Director
achievements.summary: In Call of the Dead, kill George Romero, the Director.

guide.context: He has 250,000 health for each player in the game.

steps.text: Fight George with strong weapons until he dies.

achievements.description: In Shangri-La, acquire the focusing stone.
achievements.summary: In Shangri-La, get the Focusing Stone from the main Easter egg.

guide.context: The base game needs 4 players. Most steps need Eclipse Mode, which ends after each step and can be entered again next round.

steps.text: Turn on the power (flip both switches in the power room). Hit the 4 spawn-room buttons simultaneously to enter Eclipse Mode.
Press the button under the statue near the MPL wall buy, then step on the 24 floor tiles; two players must step on matching symbols until all are pressed in.

At the end of the minecart tunnel, one player stands on the grate at the bottom of the water slide, three players join them and the fourth slides down from the top, holding USE on the right to pull a hidden lever.

At the top of the slide, hit the crystal in the rock with the Ray Gun or an explosive, then using the @item{31-79 JGb215}, and finally knife it. Follow it around to the geyser beside the slide and ride the geyser up so the crystal lands on the podium.

In the tunnel by the MPL wall buy, turn the valve 4 times so gas leaks from 4 pipes. Lead a Napalm zombie from the start of the tunnel to the power room without letting it explode, so it lights all 4 pipes, then flip the lever beside the valve.

At the tunnel leading to the foot of the waterfall (not the one to the power room), plug the 4 wall holes by placing @item{Spikemores} in front of each and detonating them. Then press the button at the waterfall's base.

Knife all 12 wall panels: five in the spawn room, two in the mud room, two in the Stakeout room, two near the minecart and one left of the power switch. Then destroy the snare trap outside, where the minecart ride begins, using a frag, Semtex or a Monkey Bomb.

First use the radio on the bench next to the window where the minecart ride starts. Then set the 4 mud room dials to 16, 1, 3 and 4 (1 = one dot, 3 = three dots, 4 = four dots, 16 = a C, a line and a dot).

Use a second radio at the foot of the Pack-a-Punch stairs, left side. Then take your upgraded @item{31-79 JGb215} and knife the 4 right gongs out of the 8; a wrong gong makes your character complain and turns the crystal above the mud room red.
One player catches the dynamite below the crystal above the geyser while another shoots the crystal with the @item{Fractilizer}; hold USE to catch it. If you miss, repeat the gong step.
Shoot the crystal above the mud room with the Fractilizer, step on all 4 slabs to activate Pack-a-Punch and place the dynamite where the machine was.
Back in the present, power up Pack-a-Punch once more and take the Focusing Stone from the altar behind the opened wall.

achievements.description: In Shangri-La, kill a Shrieker zombie while blinded by it.
achievements.summary: In Shangri-La, kill a Shrieker while its scream has you blinded.

steps.text: Let a Shrieker blind you with its scream, then kill it with an explosive or a wonder weapon.

achievements.description: In Shangri-La, dispose of a Napalm zombie without it harming any players.
achievements.summary: In Shangri-La, kill a Napalm zombie so that no player takes damage from it.

steps.text: When a Napalm zombie spawns, keep all players away from it and kill it.

achievements.description: In Shangri-La, get something from the monkeys.
achievements.summary: In Shangri-La, take a power-up that a monkey has stolen.

guide.context: The power-up must be taken while the monkey is still stealing.

steps.text: Kill a zombie so it drops a power-up and let a monkey pick it up, which changes the drop.
Kill the monkey, then pick up the power-up before it disappears.

achievements.description: In Shangri-La, use the 31-79 JGb215 on each type of zombie.
achievements.summary: In Shangri-La, shoot each of 4 zombie types with the 31-79 JGb215.

guide.context: The four types are normal, Shrieker, Napalm and Zombie Monkey.

steps.text: Get the @item{31-79 JGb215} from the Mystery Box and shoot one of each type.

achievements.description: In Moon, complete Richtofen's grand scheme.
achievements.summary: In Moon, finish the first part of Richtofen's grand scheme by opening the MPD with Samantha inside.

guide.context: You can do this solo.

steps.text: Turn on the power at the switch opposite the MPD in the main cave.
Play Samantha Says at the 4 consoles by the Tunnel 6 door, outside the Receiving Area, until all 4 screens blink green.
Take the Hacker in the lab, hack one of the 4 wall buttons on the second floor, hack the 4 panels with green lights, then press USE on all 4 lit panels within 60 seconds.

Let Excavator Pi decompress Tunnel 6 and hack its terminal to move it. Knife the Vril Sphere in Tunnel 6 and follow it, shooting it with the combined Zap Gun when it lands on the dish above the Receiving Area and when it sticks in the Tunnel 11 ceiling.
Kill 25 zombies near the tube that rises, then pull the switch on the MPD.

achievements.displayName: One Small Hack for a Man...
achievements.description: In Moon, hack something.
achievements.summary: In Moon, use the Hacker on something.

steps.text: Pick up the Hacker and hack any hackable object.

achievements.description: In Moon, become trapped in the Receiving Area and free yourself through resurrection in co-op.
achievements.summary: In Moon co-op, be trapped in the Receiving Area and freed by being revived on the other side.

steps.text: Allow Excavator Pi and Excavator Omicron to break through Tunnels 6 and 11. One player without the Hacker must already be on the far side before the second one arrives.
That player goes down and the others survive the round so the downed player respawns on the other side.

achievements.description: In Moon, purchase every perk in one game.
achievements.summary: In Moon, buy every perk in one game.

steps.text: Buy Quick Revive and 3 other perks, go down and get revived, then buy the other 4 perks.

achievements.description: In Moon, acquire 3 pack-a-punched weapons at the same time.
achievements.summary: In Moon, carry three Pack-a-Punched weapons at once.

steps.text: Pack-a-Punch 3 weapons and keep them all in your inventory.

achievements.description: In Moon, prevent each excavator from breaching the base in one game.
achievements.summary: In Moon, keep every excavator out of the base during a single game.

steps.text: Each time the PA says an excavator is moving, go to the Receiving Area and hack the flashing console that belongs to it.

achievements.description: In Moon, gain sweet, sweet, revenge.
achievements.summary: In Moon, destroy the Earth with the final step of the Easter egg.

guide.context: You need 4 players for every step after Cryogenic Slumber Party. Finish that step first.

steps.text: Knock the hexagonal panels from the shelf right of the Area 51 perk machine with a cooked grenade, then throw a @item{Gersh Device} at them to send them to the teleporter. At Griffin Base's Receiving Area another player throws a @item{Quantum Entanglement Device} at them to send them to the computer terminal.

Carry the silver tube from the lab (often at the top of the third-floor stairs) to the terminal. As Richtofen, load the Vril Device together with the Focusing Stone and keep pressing USE until the screen goes green.
As Richtofen, take the Supercharged Vril Device to the MPD, fill the 4 tubes that rise and insert the device.
Hit the Vril Sphere with a Quantum Entanglement Device so it moves outside, then complete Samantha Says 3 times to raise 3 rockets.
Finally throw one more Gersh Device onto the Vril Sphere lying on the ground.
